mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qr_manage_menu (shop_id, category_id, name, description, price, primary_image_id, sort_order, is_visible, is_sold_out, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{primaryImageId}, #{sortOrder}, #{isVisible}, #{isSoldOut}, NOW(), NOW())
